correctness.rationale: Affine inverse projection reduces every generic viewpoint to a planar rectangle-plus-point hull. Exactly the four side strips yield five vertices. The induced bivariate Cauchy density integrates exactly to formula (1). The sign of the height derivative is F(h²)-(a+b), and F has a negative derivative with positive polynomial numerator. Fixed-area shape derivative (8) is strictly positive. Unique root and thin-base asymptotic follow analytically. Finite independent projected hull diagnostic VERIFY_OK supplements but does not replace proofs.

value.rationale: A natural full family of right rectangular pyramids has an exact nontrivial random silhouette law, unique optimal height, and strong strict shape transition: at equal area and fixed height the square minimizes five-vertex frequency and an elongated rectangle drives optimal probability to 1 with a sharp 4/(π√r) law. These are interpretable previously non-implied quantitative invariants, not mere numerical special cases.
